GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 250 (1 Nov 45) GB
(SCAPIN - 223)
1 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office.
SUBJECT : Saluting.
The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to instruct the officers and men of the Police Force that they will salute all officers of the United States Occupation Forces and, in particular, all automobiles bearing the star insignia of General Officers and Flag Officers.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
